signal_hypotheses.feature: Proportion of clean liftoffs that continue positive excess return over a 20-day horizon
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Track 20-day post-liftoff excess returns for all clean liftoffs
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: If <40% of clean liftoffs sustain positive excess return, the signal is too optimistic and needs review.
